gloss: happiness in the afterlife; rest in peace

definitions.gloss: happiness in the afterlife; rest in peace
definitions.explanation: Blessedness or peace in the world after death. Almost exclusively used in the set expression ご冥福をお祈りします (We pray for your peaceful rest), a standard condolence phrase.

examples.japanese: ご{冥福|めいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We pray for your peaceful rest. (Rest in peace.)

examples.japanese: ⟦{亡|な}くなられた→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{冥福|めいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: We sincerely pray for the peaceful rest of the deceased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}→犠牲者：18769_giseisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{冥福|めいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧、ご⟦{遺族|いぞく}→遺族：14886_izoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{哀悼|あいとう}→哀悼：15556_aitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{表|ひょう}します。
examples.english: We pray for the peaceful rest of the victims and express our deep condolences to the bereaved families.

notes:
USAGE:
{冥福|めいふく} is almost always used in the set expression ご{冥福|めいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧, the standard way to express condolences in Japanese. It is appropriate for formal contexts such as funerals, memorial services, and official statements. The word comes from Buddhist terminology.
Some consider this expression inappropriate for non-Buddhist families, since {冥福|めいふく} is rooted in Buddhist beliefs about the afterlife. In such cases, ⟦{哀悼|あいとう}→哀悼：15556_aitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{表|ひょう}します (expressing condolences) is a more neutral alternative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{冥福|めいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧ (standard condolence phrase)
- ご{冥福|めいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧ (to pray for the deceased's peace)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧ご{冥福|めいふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧ (sincerely praying for peaceful rest)
